descricao_original: Cytokinesis in meiosis I results in the formation of two daughter cells, each with a single set of chromosomes (haploid, 1N). The nuclear envelope has reformed and chromosomal DNA may decondense somewhat, but quickly recondenses. Cells rapidly progress into prophase of meiosis II without passing through a second S phase.
